messages:
daniel: Hi team, Daniel here (joined infra yesterday). Trying to finish the onboarding checklist. I can access AWS SSO but my GCP console is limited — I can't see the billing export dataset for staging. Who owns billing export and what role do I need to query the BigQuery tables? :confused:

setup-bot: Welcome Daniel! Onboarding ticket created: ONB-4791. Please attach your employee ID to the ticket.

elena: welcome! :wave: Billing export BigQuery dataset is owned by Finance. To query the exported billing tables you need `roles/bigquery.dataViewer` on the billing export dataset and `roles/billing.viewer` on the billing account. We don't grant dataset-level perms automatically to new hires.

leo: hi Daniel — finance here. The billing exports are sent to project `redwood-billing-exports`. We restrict access because the dataset contains cost data across prod/dedicated/private. If you explain the use case we can grant dataset viewer scoped to `redwood-billing-exports.staging_costs` for 30 days. What's the query you need to run?

daniel: thanks. I need to run a simple join to map sku ids to our internal tag keys for a cost spike investigation in staging (one-off). Sample query: ```SELECT invoice_month, sku_description, SUM(cost) FROM `redwood-billing-exports.staging_costs.gcp_billing_export_v1_*` WHERE usage_start_time >= '2026-03-01' GROUP BY invoice_month, sku_description;```

leo: that seems reasonable. Please add the justification to ONB-4791 and I'll approve a 30-day dataset viewer grant.

elena: operational note: you may also need `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` on the service account used by any CI job that queries BI datasets. If you're using Cloud Shell with your user, `gcloud auth login` + `bq query` should work once we add bigquery viewer.

daniel: tagged the ticket with justification and linked the query. Also: curious about cross-project access for debugging — sometimes I need VM console access in the `staging-ops` project. Should I ask for `roles/compute.instanceViewer` there or a broader role?

elena: prefer least privilege. Give the exact resources or project and we'll add `roles/compute.instanceViewer` on `projects/staging-ops` for 7 days. If you need to SSH into instances, we'll arrange an ephemeral access flow via the bastion (no permanent SSH keys).

daniel: noted. One more: is there a separate billing account for Dedicated vs Hosted? I saw a billing account id in the billing console but not sure which covers staging.
